notes: Use the attack direction captured when windup begins; do not change authored rows in the middle of the action.
Frames 0 and 1 are anticipation, frame 2 begins the dash, frame 3 is the compact strike, frame 4 is braking, and frame 5 settles.
Keep the world-space hover anchor stable; forward travel comes from enemy movement code, not an additional sprite offset.
The sprite contains no shadow, glow, light trail, wind arc, particles, damage number, HP bar or hit flash; keep those game-rendered.
Damage and dash impact effects must occur once when attack frame 3 begins.
